deviations.description: Phase 6's own task list says 'Run the complete gate set: bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh' with no scoping
deviations.reason: The dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive (this dispatch is one of several implement-phase dispatches in a multi-task /orchestrate batch) explicitly overrides this for the plan's final full-tier phase: discharge against a scoped narrowing invocation covering files this phase touched, deferring the complete 29-gate battery to the once-per-invocation batch-level stage. Ran the scoped invocation bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 3,4,5,13 (doc-lint, task-reference lint, manifest parity/content-hash equality, whole-tree orphan detection -- the gates that directly verify redeploy correctness), plus merge_spec.lua directly (the repo-specific spec check, an unmappable criterion neither narrowing invocation runs). All pass.
